title: Eurosl Segway is the best!
text: The easiest way to discover main center of Barcelona on escooter or segway. Easy to drive, perfect level live guiding, small group. Electric scooters are quite new in perfect condition.
author: Euro_S

title: Lovely experience
text:
Easy to drive, friendly team. The guide Phil was attentive, helpful and knowledgeable. 
Barcelona is lovely city, and scooters from Segway are perfect option to g around.
author: Euro_S
